How do I use it properly the very first time?
To use it the first time, prep clean, oil-free lashes with Pre-Cleanse, apply a light coat of Whisper Light Bond to the roots, and let it sit for 30–60 seconds until tacky.
Place your Gossamer lashes 1-2mm above your waterline under your natural lashes, then use the Fuse Control Wand with Wandoms to squeeze them securely into place. Is there anything else I can help you with?
